entities.name: Counter-Reformation
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: The Catholic Church's internal reform movement (c. 1545-1648) responding to the Protestant Reformation. Centered on the Council of Trent (1545-1563), the Counter-Reformation clarified Catholic doctrine, reformed clerical abuses, established seminaries for training priests, and launched global missionary campaigns through the Jesuit order.
